source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιοι Πάντες Ιεράρχες εν Νόβγκοροντ της Ρωσίας»

attestations.note: One of twelve hierarchs of Novgorod whom the page enumerates by name, each with the year of his repose; his is 1060. The page also keeps the same synaxis on 4 October and on the third Sunday after Pentecost, which are not this row's feast. saint.gr calls the twelve Ιεράρχες and gives no see-rank for him individually.
